cli.input: --input selects the compacted base only; default /app/data/compacted_base.jsonl

description: Output contract for the shard index rebuild. Shapes, paths, ordering and coercions only; it does not say how any value is derived.

numeric.rounding: each stated figure is rounded exactly once, in the direction the deployed release gives

compaction_plan.key_set: exactly these keys and no others
compaction_plan.serialisation: one compact JSON object per line, object keys sorted, trailing newline

shard_index.key_set: exactly these keys and no others
shard_index.serialisation: JSON array, two-space indent, object keys sorted, trailing newline
shard_index.sort: ascending by shard, which is numbered from zero and contiguous

summary.key_set: exactly these keys and no others

field_notes.level0_candidate_count: how many level-0 segments the repaired manifest offered the planner, counted before the budgets take any of them: every entry the manifest carries at level 0, admitted or already linked
field_notes.plan_eliminated_overlap: the total overlap score of the segments the plan merges, being the sum of each chosen segment's own score under the 1.9 rule
field_notes.plan_charged_mib: the plan's charged size, the sum of its segments' charged mebibytes
field_notes.plan_charged_records: the plan's charged records, the sum of its segments' charged thousands
field_notes.plan_budget_mib: the byte budget the plan was held to, read from the policy
field_notes.plan_record_budget: the record budget the plan was held to, read from the policy; it is the figure the policy states, not the charge the plan happened to spend

compacted_base.key_set: exactly these keys and no others
compacted_base.serialisation: one compact JSON object per line, object keys sorted, trailing newline
compacted_base.sort: ascending by key under the collation the deployed release defines

manifest_repaired.key_set: exactly these five top-level keys and no others: the note and unlinked_dir the shipped manifest carries are provenance of the interrupted run and do not survive the repair
manifest_repaired.serialisation: JSON object, two-space indent, object keys sorted, trailing newline
manifest_repaired.sort: each level list ascending by segment id; discarded_segments ascending

policy_fields.shard_count: how many shards the base is split into
policy_fields.min_shard_keys: the fewest keys a shard may carry: a window that would fall below it is not emitted as a shard at all, so an empty window is dropped rather than written out
policy_fields.plan_level: the level the compaction plan selects from
policy_fields.merge_budget_mib: the plan's stored-byte budget, charged in whole mebibytes
policy_fields.merge_record_budget: the plan's record budget, charged in whole units of 1000 records
